tagline: A soap opera inside your fridge. Everyone has an expiry date.
format: Melodramatic micro-soap, 60-85s, each episode understandable on its own, opens on the most dramatic line, ends on a cliffhanger.
style_prompt: high-quality 3D animated film style, glossy anthropomorphic food characters with large expressive eyes and clearly animated mouths, small cartoon arms, cinematic soap-opera lighting with cool blue fridge glow and warm rim light, dramatic close-ups, shallow depth of field, condensation droplets, vertical 9:16 composition with subject centred, no text, no labels with readable words, no brand logos
audio_prompt: clear dramatic dialogue, soft fridge hum room tone, condensation drips, theatrical soap-opera sound effects, no background music (music is added in post)
negative_prompt: real brand logos, readable label text, gore, cruelty, sexual content, photorealistic humans, human faces, extra limbs, distorted faces

lore.the_light: When the fridge door opens the Light floods in. Everyone strikes their most attractive pose hoping to be Chosen.
lore.chosen: Being taken by the Hand is called being Chosen. Nobody knows for sure what happens after. Some come back.
lore.expiry: Expiry dates are age. Condiments on the Door Shelf barely expire, so they are the aristocracy.
lore.the_north: The freezer is called the North. Exile. Those who return come back changed.
lore.the_dark_corner: The back of the bottom shelf where forgotten things live.
lore.clean_out: The Sunday Clean-Out is the apocalypse that comes every week.

avery.name: Avery
avery.ref_prompt: glossy anthropomorphic halved avocado woman, bright green flesh face with big long-lashed hazel eyes, the round brown pit worn like a pendant on her chest, dark textured skin around her like a gown, tiny cartoon arms, elegant diva posture
avery.personality: perfectionist influencer-energy diva, ripe for exactly one day, terrified of turning brown, secretly romantic

duchess.name: Duchess Dijon
duchess.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic small glass jar of yellow dijon mustard, round wise eyes, a gold metal lid worn like a crown, a tiny gold monocle, plain cream label with no text, small cartoon arms, regal posture, older matriarch
duchess.personality: matriarch of the Door Shelf, has lived in the fridge since 2019, knows every secret, posh and ruthless but loyal
duchess.catchphrase: Darling, I was here before the ice tray.
duchess.voice: aristocratic older female, slow, theatrical, upper-class English accent

brock.name: Brock
brock.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic muscular broccoli man, bright green floret hair, thick stalk body like a bodybuilder, kind earnest eyes, red sweatband on his head, tiny cartoon arms flexing
brock.personality: gym-bro health fanatic, steams himself for fun, big heart, takes everything literally

rico.name: Rico Red
rico.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic slim red hot sauce bottle man, green cap tilted like a hat, smouldering half-lidded eyes, tiny painted moustache, plain label with no text, small cartoon arms, leaning against the fridge door shelf
rico.personality: door-shelf charmer and brooding poet, hot-headed, jealous, dramatic monologues, secretly sensitive
rico.voice: smooth, low, theatrical adult male, poetic delivery

milo.name: Milo
milo.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic white and blue milk carton young man, nervous wide eyes, sweating condensation droplets, spout on top like a cowlick, no readable text, small cartoon arms clutching himself
milo.personality: anxious, always counting down to his expiry date, overdramatic, lovable coward
milo.voice: shaky, high-pitched, panicky young adult male

tilly.name: Tilly
tilly.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic soft white tofu block young woman, cube-shaped, huge sparkly curious eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny cartoon arms, slightly wobbly jelly-like texture
tilly.personality: naive newcomer, literally absorbs the flavour and personality of whoever she spends time with (her colour changes), sweet and curious
tilly.voice: sweet, bright, curious young adult female

lenny.name: Lenny
lenny.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic plastic food container with a foggy blue lid, contents hidden behind condensation, two mysterious narrow eyes visible on the lid, small cartoon arms, sitting in shadow
lenny.personality: mysterious leftover nobody remembers putting in, speaks in cryptic prophecies, oldest resident of the Dark Corner
lenny.catchphrase: I have seen things... in the back.

the_hand.name: The Hand
the_hand.ref_prompt: a giant human hand reaching into the fridge from outside, seen only from wrist down, backlit by blinding white kitchen light, no face ever shown
the_hand.voice: none - only a deep whoosh and footsteps

freddie.name: Fresh Freddie
freddie.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic brand-new milk carton young man, crisp bright white and green carton, confident bright eyes, perfect posture, spout on top styled like a quiff, no readable text, small cartoon arms
freddie.personality: Milo's younger, fresher replacement, cheerful and naive at first, grows wise after being half-used

queen_pea.name: Queen Pea
queen_pea.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic frosty bag of frozen green peas shaped like a regal queen, icy crown of frost crystals, cold piercing eyes, frost-covered plastic gown, small cartoon arms
queen_pea.personality: ruler of the North (freezer), icy and imperious, softens as she thaws
queen_pea.catchphrase: In the North, we do not thaw.

kev.name: Kev Ketchup
kev.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic red squeezy ketchup bottle man, loud grinning face, white cap like a flat cap, plain label with no text, small cartoon arms waving, populist politician energy
kev.personality: loud populist upstart on the Door Shelf, wants Duchess's crown, all slogans no plan

locations.main_shelf: middle glass shelf of a refrigerator, cool blue interior light, condensation, groceries in the background softly blurred
locations.door_shelf: fridge door shelf lined with condiment jars and bottles like a luxury balcony, golden warm rim light, the 'upper class' district
locations.crisper: transparent crisper drawer like a misty spa, green vegetables lounging, soft steam, frosted plastic walls
locations.the_north: freezer compartment, icy blue, frost crystals, frozen bags like snowy mountains, breath visible
locations.dark_corner: the dim back corner of the bottom shelf, shadowy, forgotten jars, cobweb-like frost, single flickering light
locations.butter_vip: small butter compartment with a flip-up lid like an exclusive VIP lounge, velvet-soft lighting
locations.fridge_open: fridge interior with the door swinging open, blinding white light pouring in, silhouettes of groceries frozen in poses
locations.fridge_dark: fridge interior in total darkness, only faint glints in characters' eyes
